utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell — I’m still waiting on the exact day and time so I can make sure the pickup plan works with school. If you hear back first, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything. If you get the time, I can help with the pickup plan too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for the time, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still good for today, right? Just text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still good for today—no changes on my end. I’ll text you right away if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out. Text me right away if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Opal. Send me the details and time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — just send me the date, time, and location for the repair drive, and I’ll keep it straight for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll send the date, time, and location over, and then I can plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan as it comes together so everyone stays in the loop, and I’ll let you know if we need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — the more folks hear about it, the better. And if you do need an extra hand, just say the word and I’ll spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan and pass along any updates so everyone stays in the loop. And if we need more help, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details and time right over. It’d be great to see you there if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the details and I’ll line up the tools and checklist so we’re ready to go. I’m glad to help get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Rosa — I’ll send the details and time over right away. Thanks for lining up the tools and checklist; I really appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I'll slot in once I’m there and help with the tools list and the repair checklist. If you’ve already got the first few items, I can pick up right where you leave off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ve got the first few items started, so jumping in on the tools list and checklist will help a lot. I’ll text you if anything shifts before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for your text and jump in as soon as I arrive. If you need anything else lined up before then, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. If you can help with the repair drive, I’d be grateful—starting with the front gate would help me most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I can help coordinate that, and starting with the front gate makes sense. Once I know the repair drive timing, I’ll work it around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. I appreciate you fitting it around pickup and drop-off—just let me know the timing when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll take the front gate first and tighten anything loose.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo—that sounds like a solid first step. Let me know if you run into anything else while you’re at it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll start with the gate and report back if I find anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Still checking the supply list, Bo. I should be able to pin down a date soon and I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—thanks, Cleo. I’m keeping things moving on my end and will be ready when you’ve got the date.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’m finishing up the supply check now, and I’ll send the date as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you pass along that we’re still finalizing the repair drive plan, and I’ll share the details as soon as they’re set. If anything needs repeating, I’m happy to help keep folks in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks the plan’s still being finalized and that you’ll send the details soon. Happy to help keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — if you’ve got any spare tools or screws for the repair drive, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I can bring over that squeaky chair and see if anyone’s got a wrench for it, too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Oren — thanks. The chair and a wrench would both be really useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you need me to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — if you can, please send me the date, time, and location for the repair drive, plus anything you’re bringing by. I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll send over the date, time, and location, and I’ll bring any spare screws or useful tools I find in my toolbox.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
